description: Mobile single-panel switching with animations and skeleton loading (T-407, T-408, T-411). Enhance the existing responsive layout to properly handle mobile panel transitions with slide animations, back button behavior, and add skeleton loading placeholders for both chat room list and message list.
steps: Update app/javascript/mastodon/features/dm/index.tsx to: (a) Add CSS transition classes for panel switching instead of just display:none, (b) Use useNavigate() for proper back button handling - when on mobile in a room view, clicking back should navigate to /conversations (list view), (c) Add a back button in the message view header on mobile (visible only below 768px), (d) Integrate with browser History API so hardware/browser back button works correctly.

Create app/javascript/mastodon/features/dm/components/skeleton_loading.tsx with two variants: (a) ChatRoomListSkeleton - renders 5-6 placeholder items mimicking chat_room_item layout (gray pulsing rectangles for avatar, name, preview), (b) MessageListSkeleton - renders alternating left/right placeholder bubbles mimicking message layout. Use CSS @keyframes pulse animation.
Update app/javascript/mastodon/features/dm/components/chat_room_list.tsx to show ChatRoomListSkeleton while isLoading is true and items are empty.
Update app/javascript/mastodon/features/dm/components/chat_room_view.tsx to show MessageListSkeleton while messages are loading for the first time in a room.

Update app/javascript/mastodon/features/dm/components/chat_room_header.tsx to: (a) accept an optional onBack prop, (b) render a back arrow button when onBack is provided (mobile mode), (c) style the back button consistently with the existing header.

Add SCSS to app/javascript/styles/mastodon/dm.scss for: (a) .dm-panel-left--slide-out / .dm-panel-right--slide-in animations using transform:translateX with 250ms ease-out transitions (per design doc section 8.3), (b) .dm-skeleton-item (pulsing placeholder with @keyframes shimmer), (c) .dm-skeleton-avatar, .dm-skeleton-text-line, .dm-skeleton-bubble classes for the two skeleton variants, (d) .dm-chat-room-header__back-btn for the mobile back button.
acceptance_criteria: On screens < 768px, only one panel is visible at a time
Selecting a room transitions from list to message view with a slide-left animation
The back button in the message view header navigates back to the list with slide-right animation
Browser back button works the same as the header back button on mobile
Skeleton placeholders show while chat room list is loading
Skeleton placeholders show while messages are loading for a newly opened room
findings: All pre-commit hooks passed (eslint, stylelint, tsc, oxfmt, i18n:extract). Used useHistory from react-router-dom for navigation. The back button is rendered conditionally via the onBack prop and hidden on desktop via CSS media query (display:none by default, display:flex below 767px). The mobile panel transition uses transform+opacity with 0.25s ease-out instead of display:none for smooth animations.
